searchText: Staking pools doesn't know the index of a validator before it was deployed, because of that they use pubkey. So the pubkey is the only thing to authorize EL exit in some pool designs Ah okay. Thanks, that makes sense. That would be good info to include in the EIP’s rationale section. Yes, definitely! Will make this into the Rationale Looking up validators by pubkey requires a pretty expensive lookup table though, sadly - or a linear scan clients maintain (pubkey, index) caches anyway, can't this cache be used in this place too? yes, clients can / should optimize this. In most cases it'll be O(1), not O(n) I'm pretty sure it's not the first time clients have to translate pubkey -> index from core context Messy to maintain, we only do when forced, constructing is expensive too Deposits is the only other really mandatory place in state transition Ie we don't allow a cache like this to leak into state transition to keep St clean
